The local strategy checks hypotheses, direction, well-definedness, and its transitive dependency closure; no missing, circular, forward, B-page or out-of-plan proof supplier remains. Every plane automorphism is az+b. If a!=1 it fixes b/(1-a), contradicting freeness, so G is a discrete additive subgroup of C. Discreteness follows from proper discontinuity on a compact disc. Project G to a line perpendicular to a shortest nonzero vector v; if the projection accumulated at 0, reduce representatives modulo Zv into a bounded strip, obtaining an accumulation in G, contradiction. Thus the projection is either 0 or hZ. Compactness of C/G rules out projection 0 and gives a nonzero h. Choose w with projection h; subtract multiples of w and then v to show G=Zv+Zw, with v,w real-linearly independent. The closed fundamental parallelogram is compact and its opposite-edge identifications form the one-handle torus; by the published topological genus definition the quotient has genus one. Full AC is inherited through that genus definition, not needed for the finite lattice argument.
